whenToUse: A one-line, time-boxed notice at the top of a website: holiday closure, new release, limited offer.
A dismissible notice whose state the server reads from a cookie.
avoidWhen: Anything that needs more than one sentence.
a11y: Lives in a labelled region above the navbar; the dismiss button has an accessible name.
Keep the link text meaningful on its own (Read the v2.4 notes, not Click here).
